title: Home
metaDescription: Discover a welcoming church family in Park, Sheffield, with Sundays, community life, talks, and practical next steps for newcomers.

sections.title: Welcome Home
sections.body: A community of Jesus-followers in Park, Sheffield. We belong to the family of God, love and serve our city, and give Jesus praise in everything we do.

image.alt: People gathering together inside St John's Park

sections.title: Join on Sunday
sections.body: Our Sunday gathering is friendly, informal, and rooted in worship, Scripture, prayer, and time together afterwards. Stay for refreshments, bring your questions, and come as you are.
points: Services are usually a little over an hour.
Children and young people are welcome and included.

image.alt: People chatting over refreshments after church

sections.title: Belong, serve, give
sections.intro: The life of our church is shaped by worship, discipleship, service, generosity, and a real commitment to our neighbourhood.

cards.title: Belong
cards.body: Find friendship, prayer, and steady growth in faith through Sundays, children and youth ministry, and midweek community life.

cards.title: Serve
cards.body: Join teams that help us welcome people well, care for our building, support local families, and serve our city.

cards.title: Give
cards.body: Support the ministry and future of St John's Park through prayer, practical help, and financial generosity.

sections.title: Talks
sections.intro: The latest Sunday talk is always close at hand, with a simple archive when you want to keep listening.

sections.title: News
sections.intro: Keep up with community life, event announcements, and stories from St John's Park.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.body: If you would like to ask a question before visiting, or you just want to know where to start, we would love to hear from you.

image.alt: People gathered outdoors at St John's Park
